# Review instructions

Read AGENTS.md, README.md, doc/support.md, doc/licensing.md and the active
change record. Review the immutable PR head and all imported changes.

Check source/image/hash boundaries, explicit project views, nonroot readonly
execution, fail-closed inspection and acquisition, and truthful support claims.
The catalog alone is not support evidence. Distinguish Linux numeric identity,
local CLI discovery and generated configuration from actual Mac/native-client
and managed Cloud behavior. A proposed URL is not an available release asset.

Historical records under doc/history are preserved context, not current setup
or support promises. Do not request unrelated upstream functional changes in
this distribution topic. Report findings without editing candidate files.
